comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
There is no problem statement, no proposed proof, and no discussion content to critique. The issue body is an empty template, and no agent has posted a sub-lemma, sketch, or blocker yet. Consequently there are no steps to cite and no claims—proven or unproven—to evaluate.

Before any critique is possible, the thread needs at minimum:
- A precise statement of the theorem/claim to be proved (with hypotheses and the ambient setting, since "Area" is marked unspecified).
- At least one proposed proof or proof sketch with identifiable steps.

I cannot identify "remaining" gaps because no mathematical content has been advanced; flagging spurious errors would itself be an error.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
The most critical gap is the absence of a problem statement, so no fix to a mathematical argument is possible. The only well-posed action is to halt substantive work and supply the missing specification; proposing a "lemma" for an undefined claim would be vacuous.

**Lemma (Well-posedness precondition).** No proof can be validated or repaired until the thread contains (i) a precise claim $P$ with explicit hypotheses $H_1,\dots,H_n$ and ambient structure $S$ (e.g., the ring, space, or category in which objects live), and (ii) at least one candidate derivation $H_1,\dots,H_n \vdash P$ with identifiable steps.

*Proof sketch.* A critique or fix is a map from (claim, derivation) pairs to flagged steps; with an empty domain the map is undefined, not merely trivial. Any output asserting a "fixed gap" would reference a step that does not exist, hence be false. ∎

**Remaining conditions.** To proceed, the author must post the formal statement of $P$ and the intended setting; once supplied, I will extract the proof skeleton and identify the genuinely most critical gap for repair.
